reviewer: Claude Code (AI first-pass source audit; not an independent human curator)
scope: 1-based manifest positions 81-90 of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, frozen order; 10 candidates, 41 arms
blinding: self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model output NOT opened. FRDB snapshot (SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a verified) read only after dropping every column containing 'cmax'. Arms were mapped by AUC, t1/2, n, sex, and population comments. No arm was selected by outcome. Source Cmax values were read only after each arm's study/arm mapping had been fixed from non-Cmax metadata.
method_note: Single AI pass. Sources were PMDA CTD modules (minodronate K100 2009; teneligliptin K102 text layer and cited image-only A100), current PMDA IF revisions (the cited minodronate _017 and Rizumik _022 revisions are 404, so the current _020/_024 were used, with page numbers matching the citations), the cited Sawai IF, PMC HTML/XML full text (tilmacoxib, curcumin), and PubMed abstracts via E-utilities (no email/key). Xenobiotica, Springer, and Thieme originals were paywalled and time-boxed. The doxapram PMC scan PDF was bot-challenged. There was no browser automation, no .playwright-mcp writes, and no account-requiring service. IR is not inferred from route; wherever the formulation is a plain tablet or capsule not worded as IR, the row is 'verified_with_caveat'. The 71-80 report was used as schema guidance only.
unresolved_issues: Minodronic acid (18 arms): all doses are nominal minodronic acid HYDRATE. The two IF-cited revisions were replaced by the current IF 20th ed. (same page numbers). 4070 (30-min pre-meal) and 4072 (1-h pre-meal) were ruled ineligible as food-effect arms despite the FRDB FASTED label. J101 0.1/0.2 mg (frdb_4075/4076) mean Cmax is at or below the 0.05 ng/mL LLOQ with n=3, i.e. BLQ-influenced; the coordinator should decide whether to score. CL-029 elderly groups (4065/4066) are healthy adults aged 65-79.

Teneligliptin (12 arms): 7 were verified with caveat (A13 fasted and A1 SAD, 6 steps). The 5 renal/hepatic-study arms (8279, 8283, 8286, 8287, 8288) were ruled ineligible because dosing was 30 min BEFORE a standard meal, i.e. a meal within 30 min post-dose, before Tmax. The FRDB 'FASTED' label is contradicted. 8287/8288 are also hepatic-impaired. The coordinator may override for the healthy-control arms (8279/8283/8286) if 'overnight fast, meal 30 min post-dose' is accepted.
Repirinast (3 arms): only active metabolite BAY w 8199 was measured, so all 3 arms are ineligible for the parent analyte.
Doxapram frdb_2531: ruled ineligible from the abstract (enteric-coated capsules). The full text was not seen, so dose and fasting are unconfirmed.
Curcumin frdb_9848: n=3, Cmax visually estimated, non-zero pre-dose baseline (46 ng/mL), and a polysorbate-80 suspension. Verified with caveat, but data quality is poor.
Amezinium: 4778 has n unstated in the Sawai IF; the 4779 current IF revision was used (cited _022 is 404), and its SD may be an SE in the 1988 original. Doses are the metilsulfate salt.

Paywalled originals needing library retrieval: Wang 2016 Xenobiotica (ilaprazole; oral formulation likely enteric-coated), Hobbs 1978 J Pharmacokinet Biopharm (benzquinamide), Tian 2008 Arzneimittelforschung (aniracetam full table), Robson 1979 BJCP scan (doxapram confirmation), Beermann 1992 EJCP.

arms.reason: Ikeda et al., Br J Clin Pharmacol 2002, full text via PMC HTML. Step 5 of the main single-dose study: 150 mg fasted, n=6 active. Plasma unchanged JTE-522 AUC(0,inf) is 7.83±0.88 µg·h/mL, which matches FRDB. The drug was given at 09:00 after a 14 h supervised fast. Caveat: the study drug was 'uncoated tablets' from Japan Tobacco, but IR is not stated in words. Also note that blood (not plasma) concentrations are >60-fold higher because of RBC partitioning; the plasma value is the one recorded here.

arms.reason: J101 preliminary SAD, n=3 per dose. Fasted single oral dose, open-label, healthy males 20-24 y. AUC0-t 0.04 matches FRDB. The formulation was development tablets of 0.05/0.5/2 mg (K100 Table 2.7.1.1-1.a lots 5291T/5292T/5293T), so doses were multi-tablet. Cited FRDB page=26 is printed p.25. STRONG caveat: the plasma LLOQ is 0.05 ng/mL and the mean 0.072 ng/mL (n=3) is at or below it. Tmax is footnoted as a 2-subject mean (0.1 mg) or a single-subject value (0.2 mg), so the mean Cmax evidently includes BLQ values handled as zero. It is unreliable as a scoring target, and the coordinator should rule. Dose is expressed as minodronic acid hydrate (monohydrate basis).

The full text (PMC scan PDF) was bot-blocked and the PubMed/Europe PMC full-text services returned nothing, so the 300 mg arm, fasting state, n and Cmax table were not seen. The exclusion rests on the abstract formulation statement.

arms.reason: Govindaraju et al., Pharm Nanotechnol 2019 (PMC full text). This is the conventional curcumin SUSPENSION arm (AUC0-24 1360 ng·h/mL, t1/2 6.01 h, matching FRDB); the colon-targeted alginate nanosuspension arm is excluded. Material caveats: (1) n=3 per arm, although FRDB says 6; the table note reads 'mean of 3 volunteers (n=6)'. (2) Cmax was 'estimated by visual inspection of the graphs' and equals the mean-curve peak. (5) There is weak assay reporting (UFLC-PDA). IR is plausible for an oral suspension, but data quality is poor, and the coordinator should rule.

coordinator_review: Second-pass source adjudication by Codex, blinded to predictions and FRDB Cmax. PMDA 2009 K100 pp.3-6 links minodronic J101/J103/J104 and CL-029/030 to conventional film-coated tablets and dissolution data; current Bonoteo IF pp.39-41 supplies age/food-effect data. PMDA 2012 K100 pp.4-6 and K102 study summaries link teneligliptin A1/A13 to conventional tablets, with dissolution/formulation details. TILMACOXIB source states uncoated tablets; Sawai amezinium IF states an uncoated tablet. Conventional, non-modified-release tablets were adjudicated immediate release. The minodronic 0.1/0.2 mg Cmax values remain included but flagged as BLQ-influenced; curcumin, Rizumik amezinium and aniracetam retain unresolved quality/formulation caveats. No outcome or prediction values were used for these decisions.
